{#- Small helpers shared by the landing partials. -#} {#- href for an item that names either a Sphinx page or an external url. -#} {%- macro href(item) -%} {%- if item.url or item.link_url -%}{{ item.url or item.link_url }} {%- else -%}{{ pathto(item.page or item.link_page) }}{%- endif -%} {%- endmacro -%} {#- A link styled as a button (primary) or as a plain arrow link. -#} {%- macro action(item) -%} {{- item.label -}} {%- endmacro -%} {#- A code sample. Console lines starting with "$ " get their prompt wrapped so it can be dimmed and left out of a copy. -#} {%- macro sample(code, language) -%} 

  {%- for line in code.splitlines() -%}
    {%- if language == 'console' and line.startswith('$ ') -%}
      $ {{ line[2:] }}
    {%- else -%}
      {{ line }}
    {%- endif %}
{% endfor -%}
{%- endmacro -%}
